name: Allociné Ratings
description: Displays press and spectator ratings from Allociné on movie and series detail pages, plus the Classiques, Le club Aime, Les Indés, and Club Scream editorial badges.

versions.changelog: - Load editorial gelules and catalog artwork from jsDelivr, like press and spectator logos.

- Treat the AlloCiné ID on the Jellyfin item as the source of truth for ratings.
- Cache press/spectator scores and editorial badges by AlloCiné ID so a manual ID correction plus metadata refresh updates notes immediately.
- Write a missing AlloCiné ID once and never replace an ID already on the item.
- Upgrade the private ratings cache automatically so existing scores follow their AlloCiné ID.
- Show AlloCiné Les Indés and Club Scream badges alongside Classiques and Le club Aime.

- Show AlloCiné Classiques and Le club Aime badges next to press and spectator scores.
- Read movie editorial flags from the existing GraphQL query, with public-page fallback for series.

- Prefer the theatrical AlloCiné ID when Wikidata also lists a remixed or extended cut.
- Accept a unique AlloCiné ID when one of IMDb or TMDb is missing from Wikidata.
- After a complete Wikidata miss, match title and year if both IMDb and TMDb are present, and write that native ID.

- Align plugin-owned AlloCiné IDs with the private mapping from the daily scheduled task.
- Re-resolve a stale exact mapping after 180 days even when a native ID is already present.
- Backfill native IDs for upgraded 0.4.x libraries without a full metadata refresh.
- Remember exact-miss mappings so Wikidata is not retried every night.
- Leave user-typed AlloCiné IDs untouched.

- Declare a native AlloCiné identifier field for movies and series in Jellyfin's metadata editor.
- Expose a clickable AlloCiné link from a validated native identifier, without network calls.
- Participate in Jellyfin metadata refresh through a post-refresh custom provider, not a sparse remote fetcher.
- Write ProviderIds["Allocine"] only after an exact IMDb or TMDb match, never after a title/year fallback.
- Keep Press and Audience ratings in the private plugin database and never copy them into Jellyfin rating fields.
- Add a plugin option to enable or disable automatic native identifier writes.
- Include the AlloCiné identifier in the private rating cache identity so a corrected ID cannot reuse a stale score.

- Match movies and series through exact IMDb/TMDb identifiers via Wikidata and reject ambiguous or contradictory mappings.
- Cache validated identity mappings separately from ratings in a private, transactional SQLite database.
- Serve stale positive ratings immediately while applying adaptive freshness and failure backoff.
- Add an authenticated Jellyfin scheduled task that refreshes only eligible media with stable provider identifiers.
- Pace and serialize Wikidata traffic, honor bounded 429 retries, and use a Wikimedia-compliant User-Agent.
- Preserve Jellyfin's native rating fields and enforce per-user media access on the ratings endpoint.
- Keep AlloCiné badges stable between parental classification and native ratings, including with Jellyfin Enhanced.
- Coalesce frontend and backend work, guard SPA navigation races, and bound retries after persistent failures.

- Restore AlloCiné ratings when Jellyfin Enhanced rebuilds the media-information block.
- Revalidate through the server cache without retaining a permanent browser cache.

- Match movies and series through exact IMDb/TMDb identifiers when available.
- Fail closed on ambiguous matches and support Jellyfin 12 series pages.
- Restore AlloCiné badges before Jellyfin's native ratings.
- Cache ratings in a private SQLite database and refresh them through a scheduled Jellyfin task.
- Limit scheduled preloading to media with stable IMDb or TMDb identifiers.
- Add adaptive freshness, failed-lookup backoff, stale-first display, and stable badge placement.

- Cache exact provider-ID mappings separately from ratings.
- Add long-lived mapping freshness and private SQLite recovery.

- Match movies and series through exact IMDb/TMDb identifiers when available.
- Fail closed on ambiguous matches and support Jellyfin 12 series pages.
- Restore AlloCiné badges before Jellyfin's native ratings.
- Cache ratings in a private SQLite database and refresh them through a scheduled Jellyfin task.
- Limit scheduled preloading to media with stable IMDb or TMDb identifiers.
- Add adaptive freshness, failed-lookup backoff, stale-first display, and stable badge placement.
- Restrict scheduled preloading to media with stable IMDb or TMDb identifiers.
- Add a Jellyfin scheduled task to preload AlloCiné ratings for library items.
- Place AlloCiné ratings before Jellyfin native ratings on item detail pages.
- Move AlloCiné ratings to the end of the primary media-information row for a more consistent layout.
